ObjectStates.Name: BlockSquare
ObjectStates.Description: One hand, twelve hours. END TURN fires the world.
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- ===== The Global Clock — the one clock; everything else is grains =====
-- One hand, twelve hours. End Turn advances the hand and fires the world:
-- every object tagged cc-turn-listener gets onGlobalTurnEnd({turn=N}).
-- Turns are a resource ([+T]/[-T] extend or shorten the game).
-- Click an hour to warp it: ON -> REMOVED (the hand skips it; time lurches)
-- -> DOUBLED (the hand lingers there a second turn) -> ON.
-- GM Notes JSON: {"max_turns":12}

-- ===== Catalyst Core: The 13th Hour — shared block =====
-- Generated by tabletop/forge.py from game.spec.json.
-- Edit tabletop/lua/ + the spec, never build/ output.

CC = {
  game = "Catalyst Core: The 13th Hour",
  elements = {
    { addr = 0, name = "Void", opposite = "Aether", role = "Absence, nothingness", color = { r = 0.1, g = 0.06, b = 0.16 } },
    { addr = 1, name = "Fire", opposite = "Water", role = "Destruction, energy", color = { r = 0.89, g = 0.35, b = 0.12 } },
    { addr = 2, name = "Earth", opposite = "Air", role = "Stability, substance", color = { r = 0.48, g = 0.31, b = 0.13 } },
    { addr = 3, name = "Order", opposite = "Chaos", role = "Structure, pattern", color = { r = 0.91, g = 0.77, b = 0.25 } },
    { addr = 4, name = "Chaos", opposite = "Order", role = "Entropy, disruption", color = { r = 0.7, g = 0.09, b = 0.43 } },
    { addr = 5, name = "Air", opposite = "Earth", role = "Freedom, mobility", color = { r = 0.75, g = 0.85, b = 0.91 } },
    { addr = 6, name = "Water", opposite = "Fire", role = "Adaptation, flow", color = { r = 0.18, g = 0.53, b = 0.87 } },
    { addr = 7, name = "Aether", opposite = "Void", role = "Transcendence, resonance", color = { r = 0.56, g = 0.37, b = 0.85 } },
  },
  tiers = {
    { tier = 1, capacity = 10, timecoin = 100 },
    { tier = 2, capacity = 25, timecoin = 500 },
    { tier = 3, capacity = 50, timecoin = 1500 },
    { tier = 4, capacity = 75, timecoin = 4000 },
    { tier = 5, capacity = 100, timecoin = 10000 },
  },
  races = {
    { name = "Mortal", is = "Void", wants = "(contextual)", weak = "Aether" },
    { name = "Primal", is = "Fire", wants = "Aether", weak = "Water" },
    { name = "Golem", is = "Earth", wants = "Water", weak = "Air" },
    { name = "Chimeral", is = "Order", wants = "Fire", weak = "Chaos" },
    { name = "Revenant", is = "Chaos", wants = "Air", weak = "Order" },
    { name = "Outsider", is = "Air", wants = "Aether", weak = "Earth" },
  },
  classes = {
    { name = "Lord", is = "Aether", wants = "Chaos", weak = "Void", ability = "Command: forcefully move a persona to a location or order it to interact with an event." },
    { name = "Keeper", is = "Chaos", wants = "Earth", weak = "Order", ability = "(open — holds the line between what is and what was)" },
    { name = "Magus", is = "Water", wants = "Air", weak = "Fire", ability = "Transmute Void/Aether: transmute an element into Void or Aether, whichever it is most similar to." },
    { name = "Weaver", is = "Order", wants = "Fire", weak = "Chaos", ability = "(open — imposes pattern on noise)" },
    { name = "Mercer", is = "Earth", wants = "Water", weak = "Air", ability = "(open — moves value across the Rift)" },
  },
  clock = { hours = 12, max_turns = 12, eon_message = "Eon, you have awakened. The end time has come — he arrives in {turns} turns." },
  currency = { name = "Timecoin", start = 100, denominations = { 10, 100, 1000 } },
  attention = { name = "AP", per_turn = 3, note = "provisional default (bdo's notes name AP but not a per-turn amount); unspent AP converts to timecoin at end of turn" },
  shapes = {
    { label = "Block", tts = "BlockSquare" },
    { label = "Slab", tts = "BlockRectangle" },
    { label = "Wedge", tts = "BlockTriangle" },
    { label = "Pawn", tts = "PlayerPawn" },
    { label = "Die", tts = "Die_6" },
    { label = "Chip", tts = "Chip_100" },
    { label = "Checker", tts = "Checker_white" },
  },
}

function ccElem(name)
  if name == nil then return nil end
  local n = string.lower(tostring(name))
  for _, e in ipairs(CC.elements) do
    if string.lower(e.name) == n then return e end
  end
  return nil
end

function ccTier(t)
  for _, row in ipairs(CC.tiers) do
    if row.tier == t then return row end
  end
  return CC.tiers[1]
end

function ccTotal(pool)
  local n = 0
  for _, v in pairs(pool or {}) do n = n + (tonumber(v) or 0) end
  return n
end

function ccFmtPool(pool)
  local parts = {}
  for _, e in ipairs(CC.elements) do
    local v = (pool or {})[e.name]
    if v ~= nil and v ~= 0 then table.insert(parts, e.name .. " " .. v) end
  end
  if #parts == 0 then return "empty" end
  return table.concat(parts, " | ")
end

-- Every scripted object is generic + flexible: its config comes from its
-- GM Notes as JSON, merged over the given defaults. Repurpose any object
-- in-game by editing GM Notes, no Lua required.
function ccNotesConfig(defaults)
  local cfg = {}
  for k, v in pairs(defaults or {}) do cfg[k] = v end
  local notes = self.getGMNotes()
  if notes ~= nil and notes ~= "" then
    local ok, parsed = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(notes) end)
    if ok and type(parsed) == "table" then
      for k, v in pairs(parsed) do cfg[k] = v end
    end
  end
  return cfg
end

-- Buttons in scale-compensated local space: the same template works on an
-- object of any scale (the "generic shapes" promise).
function ccBtn(p)
  local s = self.getScale()
  p.function_owner = self
  p.position = { p.position[1] / s.x, p.position[2] / s.y, p.position[3] / s.z }
  p.rotation = p.rotation or { 0, 180, 0 }
  local fw = (p.width == 0 and p.height == 0)  -- width 0 + height 0 = pure label
  p.width = fw and 0 or math.max(1, math.floor((p.width or 320) / s.x))
  p.height = fw and 0 or math.max(1, math.floor((p.height or 320) / s.z))
  p.font_size = math.max(1, math.floor((p.font_size or 120) / s.x))
  self.createButton(p)
end

function ccEnsureTag(tag)
  if not self.hasTag(tag) then self.addTag(tag) end
end


local ROMAN = { "I", "II", "III", "IV", "V", "VI", "VII", "VIII", "IX", "X", "XI", "XII" }
local state = { turn = 1, max_turns = 12, hand = 12, hours = {}, linger = false }

function onSave() return JSON.encode(state) end

function onLoad(saved)
  local restored = false
  if saved ~= nil and saved ~= "" then
    local ok, s = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(saved) end)
    if ok and type(s) == "table" and s.hours ~= nil and #s.hours == CC.clock.hours then
      state = s
      restored = true
    end
  end
  if not restored then
    local cfg = ccNotesConfig({ max_turns = CC.clock.max_turns })
    state.max_turns = tonumber(cfg.max_turns) or CC.clock.max_turns
    state.hand = CC.clock.hours
    state.hours = {}
    for i = 1, CC.clock.hours do state.hours[i] = "on" end
  end
  ccEnsureTag("cc-clock")
  buildUI()
  refresh()
end

function buildUI()
  self.clearButtons()
  -- the twelve hours, a dial (indices 1..12; hour h sits where a clock face puts it)
  for h = 1, CC.clock.hours do
    local ang = math.rad(h * (360 / CC.clock.hours) - 90)
    ccBtn({ click_function = "hour" .. h, label = ROMAN[h],
            position = { 0.40 * math.cos(ang), 0.62, -0.40 * math.sin(ang) },
            width = 260, height = 260, font_size = 110,
            tooltip = "Hour " .. ROMAN[h] .. ": click to warp (remove / double / restore)" })
  end
  -- indices after the dial: END TURN = hours, status = hours + 1 (STATUS_INDEX)
  ccBtn({ click_function = "endTurn", label = "END TURN", position = { 0, 0.62, 0 },
          width = 900, height = 420, font_size = 130,
          color = { 0.75, 0.2, 0.15 }, font_color = { 1, 1, 1 } })
  ccBtn({ click_function = "ccNoop", label = "", position = { 0, 0.62, 0.17 },
          width = 0, height = 0, font_size = 90 })
  ccBtn({ click_function = "turnPlus", label = "+T", position = { 0.62, 0.62, -0.55 },
          width = 260, height = 220, font_size = 100,
          tooltip = "Gain a turn: the end comes later" })
  ccBtn({ click_function = "turnMinus", label = "-T", position = { 0.62, 0.62, -0.42 },
          width = 260, height = 220, font_size = 100,
          tooltip = "Lose a turn: the end comes sooner" })
end

local STATUS_INDEX = CC.clock.hours + 1

local function hourLabel(h)
  if state.hours[h] == "off" then return "--" end
  if state.hours[h] == "dup" then return ROMAN[h] .. "!" end
  return ROMAN[h]
end

function refresh()
  for h = 1, CC.clock.hours do
    local mine = (h == state.hand)
    self.editButton({ index = h - 1, label = hourLabel(h),
      color = mine and { 0.9, 0.75, 0.2 } or
        (state.hours[h] == "off" and { 0.15, 0.12, 0.2 } or { 0.35, 0.25, 0.18 }),
      font_color = mine and { 0.1, 0.1, 0.1 } or { 0.95, 0.9, 0.8 } })
  end
  local left = state.max_turns - state.turn + 1
  self.editButton({ index = STATUS_INDEX,
    label = "Turn " .. state.turn .. "/" .. state.max_turns
      .. "  |  hand on " .. hourLabel(state.hand)
      .. "  |  Eon in " .. math.max(0, left) })
  self.setName("The Global Clock — Turn " .. state.turn .. "/" .. state.max_turns)
end

function ccNoop() end

-- click an hour to warp it: on -> off -> dup -> on
-- (twelve handlers always exist; buildUI wires only CC.clock.hours of them,
-- and forge.validate refuses a spec asking for more than the dial has)
for h = 1, 12 do
  _G["hour" .. h] = function()
    local cur = state.hours[h]
    state.hours[h] = (cur == "on") and "off" or ((cur == "off") and "dup" or "on")
    if state.hours[h] == "off" then
      broadcastToAll("The hour of " .. ROMAN[h] .. " is deleted from the clock.", { 0.6, 0.4, 0.9 })
    elseif state.hours[h] == "dup" then
      broadcastToAll("The hour of " .. ROMAN[h] .. " is doubled — time lingers there.", { 0.6, 0.4, 0.9 })
    end
    refresh()
  end
end

function turnPlus()
  state.max_turns = state.max_turns + 1
  broadcastToAll("A turn is gained — the Eon arrives later. (" .. state.max_turns .. " turns)", { 0.3, 0.7, 0.4 })
  refresh()
end

function turnMinus()
  state.max_turns = math.max(1, state.max_turns - 1)
  broadcastToAll("A turn is lost — the Eon arrives sooner. (" .. state.max_turns .. " turns)", { 0.9, 0.4, 0.3 })
  refresh()
end

local function advanceHand()
  -- a doubled hour holds the hand for one extra turn
  if state.hours[state.hand] == "dup" and not state.linger then
    state.linger = true
    return {}
  end
  state.linger = false
  local skipped, steps = {}, 0
  repeat
    state.hand = state.hand % CC.clock.hours + 1
    steps = steps + 1
    if state.hours[state.hand] == "off" then table.insert(skipped, ROMAN[state.hand]) end
  until state.hours[state.hand] ~= "off" or steps >= CC.clock.hours
  if state.hours[state.hand] == "off" then
    broadcastToAll("Every hour is deleted — the hand spins in a clockless void.", { 0.7, 0.3, 0.9 })
  end
  return skipped
end

function endTurn()
  local skipped = advanceHand()
  -- a deleted hour the hand skips is time you lose: each one costs a turn
  -- ("you go from 12 to 2 — you lose a turn but something else might happen")
  state.turn = state.turn + 1 + #skipped
  if #skipped > 0 then
    broadcastToAll("The hour" .. (#skipped > 1 and "s" or "") .. " of "
        .. table.concat(skipped, ", ")
        .. " never come" .. (#skipped > 1 and "" or "s")
        .. " — " .. #skipped .. " turn" .. (#skipped > 1 and "s are" or " is")
        .. " lost, and something stirs...", { 0.7, 0.3, 0.9 })
  end
  -- the world computes: biomes generate, events fire
  local fired = 0
  for _, o in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
    if o ~= self and o.hasTag("cc-turn-listener") then
      o.call("onGlobalTurnEnd", { turn = state.turn })
      fired = fired + 1
    end
  end
  local left = state.max_turns - state.turn + 1
  if left <= 0 then
    broadcastToAll("THE EON HAS ARRIVED. Count the grains: time against timelessness decides the world.", { 0.95, 0.8, 0.2 })
  else
    broadcastToAll("Turn " .. state.turn .. " begins — the Eon arrives in " .. left
        .. " turn" .. (left == 1 and "" or "s") .. ". (" .. fired .. " listener"
        .. (fired == 1 and "" or "s") .. " fired)", { 0.85, 0.75, 0.5 })
  end
  refresh()
end

-- seam for the console / chat
function ccGetClock()
  return { turn = state.turn, max_turns = state.max_turns, hand = state.hand, hours = state.hours }
end
